steps.title: A screen board explains a screen one part at a time
steps.text: Each part comes in with the sentence that says its title, lit on the screen and explained beside it.

steps.title: The arrows walk the boards
steps.text: Back and forward through every board of the call.

steps.title: The counter opens the list of boards
steps.text: Newest first, with the key points last.

steps.title: Follow the voice puts the stage back on the voice
steps.text: It shows while a board you picked by hand is in front.
